caption:
But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:201). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-17) of GET /v1/ayah/2:201/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةًۭ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "But among them is he who says, \"Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.\""
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Raw: ". 有人说：我们的主啊！求你在今世赏赐我们美好的（生活），在後世也赏赐我们美好的（生活），求你保护我们，免受火狱的刑罚。". Punctuation/spacing-only fix (stray leading period removed). No wording changed.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "또 이렇게 말하는 무리가 있나니 주여 현세에서 축복하여 주시고 내세에서도 축복하여 주시며 불지옥의 고충으로부터 구하 여 주소서". Spacing-only fix: '구하 여' -> '구하여'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "また人びとの中には（祈って），「主よ，現世でわたしたちに幸いを賜い，また来世でも幸いを賜え。業火の懲罰から，わたしたちを守ってください。」と言う者がある。"
